articles.title: SkyWest’s New Airline Contracts Support E175 Growth And Valuation Upside
articles.mainIdea: SkyWest’s New Airline Contracts Support E175 Growth And Valuation Upside
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: SkyWest’s New Airline Contracts Support E175 Growth And Valuation Upside. SkyWest, Inc. (NasdaqGS:SKYW) has secured multi year contract extensions with United Airlines and Delta Air Lines for its Embraer E175 fleet. The company is expanding its partnership with Embraer and setting out growth plans that run through 2028. These agreements increase visibility on aircraft deployment and future revenue for SkyWest's regional operations.
